chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Haytham from al-Hakam ibn Miskin from Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'For one who departs in the first departure, when does hunting become permissible for him?' He said: 'When the sun departs from the third day.' Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab al-Zayyat narrated it to me.
ai.seo_question: When does hunting become permissible for a pilgrim after the first departure?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) specifies that the prohibition on hunting for a pilgrim who departs early (Nafar al-Awwal) lifts only after sunset on the 13th of Dhu al-Hijjah, aligning with the days of Tashriq. This ruling underscores the continuity of Ihram restrictions during the extended stay in Mina, distinguishing the permissibility of hunting from the general cessation of Hajj rituals.
